1 لَهِفَ عَلَيْهِ , (inf. n. لَهْفٌ, S,) and ↓ تَلَهَّفَ , He grieved for it, or at it; regretted it; syn. جَزِنَ and تَحَسَّرَ; (S, K;) meaning a thing that had escaped him after he been at the point of attaining it: (JK, TA:) or he grieved for it, or at it; or regretted it; and was angry, or enraged, on account of it. (TA.) But see تَحَسَّرَ; and see S, voce أَسِفَ. ―
-b2- تلهّف signifies He felt, or expressed, grief, sorrow, or regret.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
